---
title: "CENS"
---

It has been a privilege to be a member of the [Council for Emerging and New Statisticians (CENS)](https://cens-enar.github.io/cens_website/) since 2024. CENS operates under the Eastern North American Region (ENAR) of the International Biometric Society (IBS), and supports students and early-career statisticians through mentorship, networking, and professional development. I served on the Steering Committee in my second year, and began a third term in 2026 serving as Co-Chair.
